query_generation: For each d, fresh Generator(PCG64(20261101)),512 uniform[-1,1]^d rows Z shared across allR; concatenate all2^d sign corners; multiply byR
kernel: Same FP64 batched-head stable weighted softmax: einsum qK, subtract row maximum, exp, normalize, weighted sum across allheads
materials: Explicit materialized K[H,M,b] and V[H,M]. native H1,b=d,M2^d; block H=d/2,b2,M4; coordinate Hd,b1,M2; mean H1,b=d,M2,K0/ones_over_d,V0/d. No broadcast views counted as head copies.
oracle: sum(1/(1+exp(-q_j))) used outside timed kernel for validation only
allocation_boundary: Build inputs,reshape,K,V,oracle outside timer. Kernel only allocates logits/softmax reductions/output through same generic kernel. Includes einsum planning overhead.
activation_boundary: Logit-array proxy only; not total peak, measuredRSS or complete operation count
finite_observation_warning: maxobservederror is not sup_allquery guarantee; no NLP/LLM claims or timing superiority promise
supervision: Root review/admission BEFORElaunch. New process group; outer120s TERM,5sKILL,reap ownprocess only. Privatework O_EXCLlock acquired by child; outer removes only matchinginode/PID afterreap ifchild killed. Allcompletedrows checkpointed; pending rows explicit.
weak_signal: Exact methods disagree numerically beyond1e-10, hidden broadcast storage or kernel timing contamination
kill: Deadline/ownership failure; preserve all completed and pending rows; no retry/seedchange
